_comment: Session routing — which Claude Code session owns which property.
Read by the SESSION ROUTING section of CLAUDE.md. The rule is: work on a
property is HANDED OFF to its owning session rather than done wherever it
was asked for, so one session holds the whole history of one property.
MATCH BY TITLE FIRST, id second. Session ids are stable for the life of a
session but a NEW session for the same property gets a new id, so a
hardcoded id goes stale silently. mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__list_sessions
returns titles; find the title, use the id it reports, and update this
A session does NOT need to be running. send_message delivers into a
stopped session's transcript as a user turn, waiting for the next open.
ListAgents will NOT show a stopped session — it only lists live peers.
That difference cost a round trip on 26 Aug 2026.
